key.name: notifications
key.description: Show a desktop notification when new mail arrives.

key.name: notification-sound
key.description: What plays with a new-mail notification unless an account overrides it: "system" for the desktop sound theme's new-mail sound, "none" for silence, or the path of an audio file.

key.name: load-remote-images
key.description: Load remote images in messages by default instead of asking.

key.name: load-sender-avatars
key.description: Fetch sender pictures from Gravatar, falling back to the sender's website icon. This tells those services who emails you.

key.name: bridge-photo-port
key.description: The loopback port where a local graphmail-bridge serves Outlook profile pictures (its server.photo_port). Accounts whose IMAP server is a plain loopback connection ask it for sender avatars before Gravatar.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep checking for new mail after the window is closed.

key.name: start-at-login
key.description: Whether the desktop portal has been asked to start Rustle hidden at login. The portal owns the autostart entry; this only records its answer.

key.name: background-notice-shown
key.description: Whether the notice about the app still checking for mail after the window is closed has been shown. It is only shown once.

key.name: download-all-mail
key.description: After each check, keep fetching the message headers every folder is still missing in the background until the whole account is here, so search and scrolling cover all your mail. Off, only the newest page of the open folder is fetched.

key.name: sync-interval-minutes
key.description: How often to check for new mail. Set to 0 to check manually only.
